description: Event created after data is replcated.

replicatedObjectId.description: The ID of the changed object.

replicatedObjectType.description: The type of the changed object

beforePathIds.description: The full path of the object before the change. Value is a json array of longs.  Will be null for create events.

afterPathIds.description: The full path of the object after the change. Value is a json array of longs. Will be null for delete events.
